title: youngs material interface
explanation:
### Description

Demonstrate vtkYoungsMaterialInterface by reading a 2D UCD dataset with volume fraction and normal data, thresholding by material, reconstructing interfaces, and rendering the wireframe mesh with surface interfaces.

**dataset → input → filter → visual_asset → renderer → infrastructure → output**

- [vtkAVSucdReader](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkAVSucdReader.html) — av sucd reader.
- [vtkActor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkActor.html) — assigns the mapped geometry to the scene.
- [vtkCompositeDataSet](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkCompositeDataSet.html) — composite data set.
- [vtkDataObject](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkDataObject.html) — provides field association constants for array processing.
- [vtkDataSetAttributes](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkDataSetAttributes.html) — data set attributes.
- [vtkDataSetMapper](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkDataSetMapper.html) — maps any dataset type to graphics primitives.
- [vtkDoubleArray](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkDoubleArray.html) — double array.
- [vtkMultiBlockDataSet](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkMultiBlockDataSet.html) — groups multiple datasets into a composite structure.
- [vtkThreshold](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkThreshold.html) — extracts cells whose scalar values satisfy a threshold criterion.
- [vtkYoungsMaterialInterface](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkYoungsMaterialInterface.html) — youngs material interface.
- [vtkRenderWindow](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindow.html) — displays the rendered scene in a window on screen.
- [vtkRenderWindowInteractor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindowInteractor.html) — captures mouse and keyboard events.
- [vtkRenderer](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderer.html) — assembles the scene and configures the camera.
- `Initialize()` and `Start()` launch the interactive visualization — `Initialize()` prepares the interactor and `Start()` begins the event loop.
